geneal — default ablation (safety + diversity)

5113 genes (data/processed/depmap/panel_5k.txt) · 1 cell lines · 1 seeds · K=10 · AL 1×5 · τ-quantile=0.5 · contrast line ACH-001360 · acq=ucb

How to read this

Two analyses, two questions, two toxicity definitions.

Safety rules (Analysis A). • greedy: top-K predicted efficacy, no safety. • truncation · known: keep the safest τ-fraction by the known toxicity (oracle ceiling). • truncation · predicted: same, but toxicity is learned by a GP from revealed labels (greedy acquisition). • EHVI: learned toxicity, with a dual-objective EHVI acquisition. • random / farthest / cluster: diversity-first baselines (no safety). trunc_known is the upper limit the learned rules chase — their gap is the cost of learning safety.

Diversity operators (Analysis B). • none: top-K by quality. • cap: ≤ c per CORUM pathway. • kdpp: quality-weighted k-DPP with a dense embedding-cosine (mechanism) similarity — never outcome similarity. Layered on three bases (greedy / truncation / ehvi).

Toxicity definitions. • contrast (primary): lethality in one fixed contrast cell line (normal-tissue stand-in). • aggregate: common-essential fraction, excluding the target line (leakage-safe). τ is a quantile (the safest fraction kept), so it is comparable across both.

Metrics (true values of the nominated portfolio): mean/max efficacy, mean toxicity; pathway concentration↓, dropout robustness↑, distinct pathways↑, α-NDCG↑.
Naive greedy carries toxicity 0.79 at efficacy 1.23. The known-toxicity ceiling (trunc_known) reaches toxicity 0.02 / efficacy 0.40; the learned ceilings (trunc_pred 0.15, EHVI 0.15) sit between — the gap to trunc_known is the price of learning safety from the embedding.

Toxicity definition: contrast (primary)

A · Safety vs efficacy — all methods

Each point a method (mean over lines × seeds, 95% CI bars). Up = more lethal, left = safer; the up-left corner is the goal.

A · Per-cell-line tradeoff (manuscript subfigures)

One panel per cell line; the same methods. Shows the safety ordering is consistent across lines, not an averaging artifact.

A · Gene landscape — nominated targets per method (all lines pooled)

Each panel a method. Grey = all candidate genes (pooled over the 1 cell lines); open circles = that method's 10 nominated targets. Safety rules pull picks left (safer); greedy/baselines reach into the toxic right.
